summary: The board called the hearing to order [02:39] and approved previous hearing minutes [07:08] along with subcommittee recommendations [14:35]. During the session, the board voted to approve relief for a 4-unit residential project [12:08], a multi-unit project with affordable housing provisos [42:09], stair and roof deck modifications subject to design review [1:00:22], a non-conforming use change [1:03:36], a 13-unit transit-oriented project on Blue Hill Avenue [1:44:40], a residential development near Truman Parkway [1:53:02], a construction proposal by CAD Builders [2:43:07], a 4-unit building project [2:50:25], a residential conversion project [3:00:23], and a 13-unit development subject to design review [3:17:36]. The board also voted to defer several matters to future dates to allow for further review or proper advertising, including a proposed development at Washington and Grove Streets [2:34:31] and a chicken coop application [2:38:30].
